267330|d8b814ea.text: Agol ne wirsh ver ne vandar novaedi veld algos nevren? Va se ras uden vrum bor garde?

179-progress.name: Sten Stoutarm
179-progress.text: Wolves giving you a bit of trouble? You'd do well to avoid the fangs and claws and other sharp bits, yes?
179-progress.title: Dwarven Outfitters

3092-progress.name: Lanka Farshot
3092-progress.text:
Welcome to Camp Narache, $N. I hear good things about you. Your bloodline is strong, and many of the elders consider you skilled already. But that we will test.

The plains of Mulgore will be your home for sometime--you should do your best to learn it very well. One day you will travel to unfamiliar lands to master greater skills. You must be ready.
3092-progress.title: Etched Note

747-progress.name: Grull Hawkwind
747-progress.text: Providing meat and feathers for the tribe is the first step in proving yourself as a $c before the Chief.
747-progress.title: The Hunt Begins

750-progress.name: Grull Hawkwind
750-progress.text: If you can provide pelts for the tribe I will pass word along to my father, Chief Hawkwind, of your generous deeds.
750-progress.title: The Hunt Continues

753-progress.name: Chief Hawkwind
753-progress.text: You look as though you have returned from the plains. Do you have any word from Greatmother Hawkwind?
753-progress.title: A Humble Task

780-progress.name: Grull Hawkwind
780-progress.text: The aggression of the Battleboars is increasing. Have you sent them a clear message and brought back some snouts and flanks yet?
780-progress.title: The Battleboars

92485-accept.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92485-accept.text:
While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident $c trainer--Xyton Silverwind--left this note for you. Read it as soon as you can, and then seek out Silverwind on the ground floor of this great tree just behind me.

Heed his words and his counsel, he can teach you much.
92485-accept.title: A Student of Nature

92485-complete.name: Xyton Silverwind
92485-complete.text:
The flora and fauna of Zephras Isle represent a rich tapestry of vibrant life. The ecosystem requires constant balance to maintain the harmony of nature, and we druids are the keepers of that balance. I see much potential in you, but this path is not an easy one, and you will need guidance as you grow in strength as a student of the fang, the claw, the feather, and the branch. 

Speak with me again if you wish to take your next steps.
92485-complete.title: A Student of Nature

92485-progress.name: Xyton Silverwind
92485-progress.text: Greetings, I am Xyton Silverwind, keeper of druidic lore.
92485-progress.title: A Student of Nature

95805-accept.name: Seer Graytongue
95805-accept.text:
The sun and the moon, An'she and Mu'sha, are not part of our world like the elements, yet their light gives us life, guidance, and hope.

We pay respect to the spirits of the world, and so we pay respect to the twins as well.

If you would show your respect, take this smoldering incense and bring it to a shrine in the hills to the southeast, overlooking the mesa, south of the quilboar. Be quick, so that you can reach the shrine before the incense burns away.

Don't get it wet!
95805-accept.title: Grace of An'she and Mu'sha
